entries.title: A one-time automation leaves your list once it has run
entries.body: A one-time automation no longer stays in the Automation panel and Settings → Automation as Done. Once it has run and Firstmate has handled it, it is removed, and Activity says so. The tasks and cards it led to stay. One-time automations that already ran are removed when the app next starts.
entries.noPicture: The change takes a finished row out of the Automation list, which no single picture can show.
